svg.text: From a drug to a lipid nanoparticle recipe made on the equipment you already have.
A drug that needs a carrier.
Our model ranks recipes for it.
Your mixer makes them, our module measures.
Hatched = predicted, not measured. Ratios illustrative.
Feedback: each result improves the next ranking
Status: research prototype. No independent lab validation yet.
